the characteristics of type 2 diabetes mellitus in terms of insulin resistance in Korea.

insulin resistance is a major determinant in the clinical features of type 2 diabetes in Korean patients, and that the clinical and biochemical features of type 1 and type 2 diabetes are different in Korea.

the insulin resistance is related with the age, hypertension, body fat content and glycemic control.
